title_en: The Mahdist Concept in the Heritage of the Two Schools (Part 1)
description_en: The Mahdist concept in the heritage of the two schools (Part 1), an episode of the Mahdist Thesis program by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari on Al-Kawthar TV channel.
summary: His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari discusses the concept of the Mahdi in the intellectual heritage of different Islamic schools, as part of the Mahdist Thesis program on Al-Kawthar TV.
